property_summary: After any actor successfully locks a guess in block b, settle() must already succeed in block b+2 (since b+2 > b+1); the mutant locks block.number+2 so settle() in b+2 still reverts because b+2 is not > b+2.
change_summary: Change the locked target block from block.number + 1 to block.number + 2, altering the stored block value.
